description: This Java source file defines a class 'ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' that implements the builder pattern for creating responses and events related to modify attribute live commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class extends an abstract builder and provides methods to create various response and event objects such as 'created', 'modified', and error responses, with thread safety annotations indicating it's not thread-safe.
